the following factors affect the rate at which a given speaker will adopt the new variant of a given variable: (1) age at the time of exposure to the variable, (2) frequency of contact with the new variant, (3) social network composition, (4) social network structure, (5) social network size, and (6) the degree to which the individual identifies with the group in which the variable is used.
